mainEntity.name: How is a Handicap Index calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each score becomes a differential: 113 divided by the slope, times the score minus the course rating (and PCC). Your index is the average of your best differentials, for example the lowest 8 of your last 20.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Handicap Index and Course Handicap?

acceptedAnswer.text: The index is portable and measures ability on a course of standard difficulty. The Course Handicap converts it to the number of strokes you receive on a specific set of tees.
Playing Conditions Calculation. It adjusts differentials for a day when conditions made the course play easier or harder than normal. It is usually 0 and is set by the club, from about −1 to +3.
Your gross score with each hole capped at net double bogey, meaning par plus 2 plus any handicap strokes you receive on that hole.

mainEntity.name: How many scores do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: At least 3. With fewer than 20 the system uses fewer differentials, and applies a small reduction for 3, 4 and 6 scores.
